crossRefs.note: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter…
Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but…
Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in…
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter…
May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have…
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.

translations.web: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
translations.bsb: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”
translations.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
